# Event bus

Services publish JSON envelopes (version 1) to Redpanda. `data` is exactly the gateway DISPATCH payload for `type` (see gateway.md).

## Envelope

### EventEnvelope

Redpanda event envelope. `data` is exactly the gateway DISPATCH payload for `type`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string (uuid)` | UUIDv7; consumers deduplicate on it. |
| `type` | `string` | Event type, e.g. MESSAGE_CREATE. |
| `v` | `1` | Envelope version. |
| `occurred_at` | `string (date-time)` |  |
| `guild_id` | `?Snowflake` | Set for guild fan-out (filtered by VIEW_CHANNEL and intents). |
| `channel_id` | `?Snowflake` |  |
| `target_user_ids` | `?array of Snowflake` | Set for per-user delivery; null for guild fan-out. |
| `data` | `any` |  |

## Routing

- If `guild_id` is set and `target_user_ids` is null, the gateway fans out through the guild process, filtered by VIEW_CHANNEL on `channel_id` and by intents.
- Otherwise the event is delivered to every session of each user in `target_user_ids`.
- Consumers are idempotent on `id` (UUIDv7); the gateway keeps an LRU of the last 10k event IDs per node.
- `CHANNEL_CREATE` is also published on `discordy.user.v1` (with `target_user_ids`) for DMs.

## Bus-only payloads

### VoiceMemberMoveEvent

VOICE_MEMBER_MOVE bus event (discordy.guild.v1, routed by guild_id). A moderator moved a member to another voice channel or disconnected them (PATCH /guilds/{id}/members/{uid} with channel_id). The gateway applies it to the member's live voice session and never dispatches it to clients; it is ignored when the member is not in voice. Clients observe the result as VOICE_STATE_UPDATE plus, for a move, VOICE_SERVER_UPDATE with a token for the new channel.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `guild_id` | `Snowflake` |  |
| `user_id` | `Snowflake` |  |
| `channel_id` | `?Snowflake` | The voice channel to move the member to, or null to disconnect them. |

### BanMessagePurgeEvent

BAN_MESSAGE_PURGE bus event (discordy.guild.v1, routed by guild_id). A moderator banned a user with delete_message_seconds > 0 (PUT /guilds/{id}/bans/{uid}). The messages service deletes every message the user authored in the listed channels at or after since_ms (storage, search index, attachments, reactions, pins) and emits MESSAGE_DELETE_BULK per channel. The gateway ignores it and never dispatches it to clients. Replays are harmless: deleting already deleted messages is a no-op.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `guild_id` | `Snowflake` |  |
| `user_id` | `Snowflake` | The banned user whose messages are purged. |
| `channel_ids` | `array of Snowflake` | The guild's text-capable channels and threads at ban time. |
| `since_ms` | `integer` | Unix milliseconds: messages created at or after this instant are deleted (ban time minus delete_message_seconds). |
| `delete_message_seconds` | `integer` |  |
